title: CF Meet Messaging events v1
description: Messaging domain events in the platform envelope (transactional outbox committed with the state change, at least once, per-aggregate order): messaging.device.registered, messaging.device.key-packages-published, messaging.device.revoked, messaging.conversation.created, messaging.conversation.lifecycle-changed, messaging.conversation.updated, messaging.policy.updated. 1.2.0 (Parts E-G): messaging.message.created / edited / deleted / moderated / expired, messaging.member.added / removed / updated, messaging.read-cursor.updated, messaging.mls.welcome-available; conversation-scoped events also carry a per-conversation event cursor in the outbox (the replay log). Ids, states and versions only — never key material, ciphertext, content or a credential. 1.5.0 (Part V I): messaging.reaction.added / removed, messaging.pin.added / removed (ids and the reaction only). 1.6.0: message events may carry conversation_id (the webhook relay to the platform webhook system). 1.8.0: messaging.pin.added carries expires_at (null without expiry). 1.9.0: messaging.device.key-packages-low. 1.10.0: messaging.conversation.successor-created. 1.11.0: messaging.member.invited, messaging.member.invitation-closed; member roles.

AttachmentStateChanged.description: An attachment reached READY, REJECTED (incl. SCAN_UNAVAILABLE), QUARANTINED or DELETED. Ids and codes only: never a file name, object key or bytes.

AttachmentDerivativeReady.description: A server derivative of a MANAGED attachment is ready; the attachment's identity is unchanged (§80).

LegalHoldApplied.description: A legal hold was applied (the case reference is never in the event).

ReportCreated.description: A member reported content (§118 message.reported). The reporter and any evidence are never in the event.

ExportChanged.description: A MANAGED compliance export became READY, FAILED or EXPIRED (§118 export.ready).

SmsTransportChanged.description: The carrier transport of an SMS-bridged MANAGED message changed state (submitted, delivered, failed, blocked). Never the text or a telephone number.

MessagePurged.description: Retention purge completed for a message: its content (ciphertext or sealed text, revisions, attachments) is gone.

DeliveryCursorUpdated.description: A member's DELIVERED position advanced (§52: a session acknowledged the message or the member synchronized past it). Only when the policy's privacy.deliveryReceipts is true.

ReadCursorSynced.description: A principal's read cursor moved; delivered to that principal's own sessions only (never another member's stream).

KeyPackagesLow.description: §136 / Appendix G.4: an ACTIVE device's usable KeyPackages fell below the configured watermark (raised once until the device publishes enough again). Counts only.

ConversationSuccessorCreated.description: Appendix G: a deliberate successor of this conversation was created (provenance; ids and profiles only).
